facts.raw_span: A 35-year-old woman with bipolar I disorder and chronic joint pain
15-month history of swelling and redness of her hands
no improvement with glove use
chronic joint pain in her hands and back
prior treatments with topical mupirocin and emollients were unsuccessful
4-year history of injecting heroin, buprenorphine, suboxone, and morphine
intermittent, painless, symmetric swelling of both hands
persistent hand and foot edema with new erythema
echocardiogram showed a normal ejection fraction
punch biopsy showed small‐vessel ectasia and minimal perivascular lymphocytes
negative antinuclear antibody, extractable nuclear antigen panel, and rheumatoid factor
Creatine kinase and aldolase were mildly elevated
